# Now create notes in Simple Note for each file
import os

for file_path, content in file_contents.items():
    # Derive title: strip directory and .md extension, replace underscores with spaces
    filename = os.path.basename(file_path)  # e.g., "Book_Reading_Lists.md"
    title = filename[:-3]  # remove .md
    title = title.replace('_', ' ')
    # Create note
    result = apis.simple_note.create_note(
        title=title,
        content=content,
        access_token=sn_token
    )
    print(f"Created note for {title}: {result}")
